facts.business: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited undertakes highway operations and maintenance services contracts awarded by government authorities, public sector undertakings, private sector and concessionaires.
key_risks: Revenue recognition involves significant management judgement in determining the stage of completion of services, identification of performance obligations, assessment of contractual modifications and claims, estimation of variable consideration, and evaluation of whether revenue was recognised only when it was highly probable that a significant reversal would not occur.
